site.label: site layers: 3DEP elevation and slope, OSM path distance, NAIP crowns; sun / moisture / pH unknown

define.intent: A coherent matrix-based planting along the paths that supports pollinators from spring to autumn.

zones.name: Path matrix
zones.role: A coherent matrix that reads as one band system along the main walks
why: B1 faces a main walk → bands following the path edge
Matrix Based: A long-lived grass / sedge matrix with emergent forbs rising through it.

zones.name: Matrix beds
why: A1 is a block bed on the original plan
Matrix Based: A long-lived grass / sedge matrix with emergent forbs rising through it.

rules: Matrix Based system where a zone has no stronger rule
beds along the main walks: curved bands that follow the path edge
ephemeral (bulb) layer kept in the systems that have one; flowering from March

foundation.note: Planting Intelligence base: mostly Metro Vancouver plants; for Detroit species it holds legend roles, 37 Robertson 1929 visitor lists (Illinois) and one applicable light record. Applied only where its place fits Detroit.

site.note: Hydrology printed on the official meadow plant lists.

illustrative.note: Teaching values (flowering, pollinators, light, moisture) for 65 Detroit plants — not a survey, not checked against a source.
illustrative.statement: Typical horticultural values written to teach the workflow when the knowledge base has no flowering or pollinator data for these species. Not a Detroit survey, not checked against a source, not evidence. Switch this layer off in Define to see what is actually known. Replace with sourced records (for example USDA PLANTS characteristics, public domain) before any real use.

constraints.text: Plants only inside the beds, never on paths, walls or structures; 0.6 m clear of existing tree trunks.
Areas outside the design scope keep the reference planting; existing trees stay.
Frozen cells are never regenerated or painted over.
A plant recorded for the other light than the local crown proxy is swapped for a layer-mate that fits, or flagged.

bed.B1.explanation: Curved bands following the bed edge along the path (distance bands), 2.5 m wide, cut into segments of about 7.5 m.

bed.B1.explanation: 19 patches from a clipped Voronoi partition (Lloyd relaxation, 2 steps) of seed layout 5 of 6: the layout whose patches mix the fewest known site conditions (tree crown, path edge, elevation tercile) and leave the fewest slivers.
notes: Sun, soil moisture and pH have no data here: they do not shape the cells.

bed.A1.explanation: 16 patches from a clipped Voronoi partition (Lloyd relaxation, 2 steps) of seed layout 3 of 6: the layout whose patches mix the fewest known site conditions (tree crown, path edge, elevation tercile) and leave the fewest slivers.
notes: Sun, soil moisture and pH have no data here: they do not shape the cells.

bed.B1.explanation: Not divided: the plantable area (232.8 m²) is one cell.
notes: Whole area: the mix arrangement (blocks, matrix, drifts) gives the pattern, not a cell grid.
